notes:
A voucher line can now be tagged with a brand, so a payment or a journal entry that settles no bill still counts towards that brand's ledger. Only brands set to track their credit separately are offered, and the column stays out of the way entirely for companies that do not use brands. When a line is linked to a bill, the bill decides the brand and the field shows what it decided.

More important for everyone: correcting a voucher on the desktop no longer clears the bill it was linked to. Editing a voucher rewrites all of its lines, and this app has never had a field for the linked bill or for the sauda an advance was paid against, so both were quietly lost every time an amount was corrected here - which left a bill that had been paid looking unpaid. Anything the app does not show is now kept as it was.
